title: The New Covenant
intro: Jeremiah 31 contains one of the Old Testament's most important promises: The New Covenant. Amidst judgment and destruction, hope shines for a completely new relationship between God and humanity—a covenant written on the heart, not on stone tablets.

items.title: Rachel Weeps
items.note: Quoted regarding the massacre in Bethlehem (Matt 2:18)

items.title: Sins Forgiven
items.note: Complete forgiveness—sins are remembered no more

footer.title: Fulfilled in Christ
footer.content: Jesus instituted the new covenant in his blood at the Last Supper (Luke 22:20). The book of Hebrews quotes Jeremiah 31 as the defining promise of the new covenant (Heb 8:8-12). In Christ, we receive the law written on our hearts by the Holy Spirit.
